messages:
anna-sales: Heads up — FinServCo demo hit a burst of 503s during the live load test. Need swarming pls. Repro steps at the bottom.

sre-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-0021. Page: @oncall-eng

alex: joining. @anna can you paste the request_id(s) and timeframe?

anna-sales: timeline: 2026-02-15 15:02-15:09 UTC. Customer sent ~15 parallel sessions, some with large prompt batches. Example request_id: req_8f3a2b. Logs:
```
[15:03:01] ERROR handler: 503 ServiceUnavailable - overload - req=req_8f3a2b
Trace: kv_cache miss + queue backlog
upstream: 127.0.0.1:5100 code=503
```

meera: looks like runtime returned 503 not nginx. Can you share model, route and config? esp batch_size, seq_len, autoscale policy.

sam: adding details from support side: route=/generate-finserv, model=rwd-micro-13b, batch_target=32, max_batch=128, min_replicas=1, scale_cooldown=120s. We observed GPU utilization spike to ~98% before autoscaler added replicas.

alex: thanks. If min_replicas=1 and cool_down=120 then autoscaler may be too slow for demo bursts. Also the scheduler had throttling: "queue_length>100 -> reject 503" policy triggered.

meera: can we get the controller logs around 15:03? run: `redwoodctl logs controller --since 20m --filter req_8f3a2b`

anna-sales: pasted controller snippet:
```
[controller] 15:03:05 scale_decision: backlog=145, current_replicas=1, target_replicas=4, scaling=false (cooldown)
[controller] 15:03:07 reject_request req_8f3a2b reason=queue_overflow
```

alex: root cause: autoscaler cooldown prevented immediate spin-up -> queue overflow -> 503 fallback. Long-term fix: reduce cooldown, increase min_replicas, or enable burst_pool.

sam: customer asks about failover behavior — will requests queue or fall back to smaller model? We saw some failover to rwd-micro-7b but many still 503.

meera: current policy was fail_fast: true; fallback_model not configured for that route. We can patch route to fallback to rwd-micro-7b with `redwoodctl route update --name generate-finserv --fallback rwd-micro-7b` — but that may affect quality.

alex: immediate mitigation steps I can take now: 1) temporarily set min_replicas=3 for the POC cluster 2) shorten cooldown to 20s 3) enable burst_pool=enabled. Any objections? @anna

anna-sales: do it pls — customer on call now. :pray:

sre-bot: Action assigned to alex.

alex: done — scaled min_replicas to 3 and set cooldown 20s. watching metrics.

sam: we're seeing 200s again for the next 5m, no 503s so far.

anna-sales: customer confirmed demo resumed. follow-up: we should add a note to deal doc about recommended POC config and add this as a presales checklist item.

meera: I'll make a PR to docs with recommended defaults and a quick playbook for POCs.

alex: recording action items: reduce cooldown default for demo routes, add fallback option to route wizard, and update presales checklist.

anna-sales: thanks all — closing thread after postmortem doc. :trophy:
